evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants, entry A00011 丙
evidence.field: 正字說明; 注音; 漢語拼音; 釋義
evidence.text: The entry identifies 丙 as A00011, gives its Mandarin reading as bǐng, and lists meanings including the third heavenly stem, the third ordinal, and a designation for fire. This verifies the modern reading of the phonetic component; it does not establish its historical sound role in 病.
evidence.title: A00011 丙 — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants, entry A02667 病
evidence.field: 正字說明; 注音; 漢語拼音; 釋義
evidence.text: The entry identifies 病 as A02667, gives its Mandarin reading as bìng, and quotes the received Shuowen analysis 疾加也。从疒，丙聲. This verifies the modern reading of the host character and records the traditional phonetic analysis; the present-day reading comparison alone does not prove that historical relationship.
evidence.title: A02667 病 — 教育部《異體字字典》

search_audit.query: site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp 丙 bǐng 教育部 異體字字典; site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp 病 bìng 教育部 異體字字典
search_audit.outcome: Search results identified Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary entries for 丙 and 病. Opened the standard-character entries and inspected their reading fields: 丙 is bǐng and 病 is bìng. The 病 entry also reproduces the Shuowen analysis 从疒、丙聲. Independently checked the supplied local HSK extract rows for both characters; these agree with the dictionary but are local validation data, not external evidence.
